_comment: MCP server definitions for the X API Skills. Apply with: mavis mcp create xmcp ... and mavis mcp create x-docs ... (see AGENTS.md). These are documented here so the configuration lives in the repo. The runtime app does not depend on these being active; they are for the agent building/maintaining the project.

x-api._comment: Hosted X MCP (XMCP) — exposes 200+ X API v2 endpoints as MCP tools. Docs: https://docs.x.com/tools/mcp

x-docs._comment: Hosted Docs MCP — search and read any docs.x.com page on the fly. Listed at https://docs.x.com/tools/ai
